initial.name: read_file
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 file within the selected workspace.

initial.name: write_file
initial.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 file within the selected workspace.

initial.name: schedule_create
initial.description: Create one reminder in the current session. Supply a non-empty prompt and exactly one selector: a positive safe-integer after_seconds delay, at as a strict offset date-time or local date/time object, or safe-integer every_seconds of at least 300. Fixed-rate reminders stay creation-aligned, skip missed occurrences, and batch one latest occurrence per overdue rule. Delivery is session-local: the reminder runs on time only while this session is live and otherwise becomes overdue until the session is resumed.

initial.name: schedule_list
initial.description: List every active reminder in the current session in creation order, including its exact id, UTC target, scheduled or overdue state, and session-local delivery mode.

initial.name: schedule_delete
initial.description: Delete one active reminder in the current session by the exact id returned by schedule_create or schedule_list. Unknown or already-finished ids return deleted false.
